name: Tsum Valley Trek
sub_region: Gorkha District (Shiar Khola valley; Chumnubri Rural Municipality wards 3, 6 and 7), Gandaki Province

difficulty.notes: No high pass on the standalone out-and-back route; highest point Mu Gompa (approx. 3,700 m). Long days on the approach along the Budhi Gandaki. Combined with the Manaslu Circuit it becomes strenuous (Larkya La). [s4, s5]

duration_days.basis: Kathmandu to Kathmandu by road, out-and-back from Machha Khola, excluding international arrival/departure days
duration_days.notes: Standalone Tsum: about 9 walking days out-and-back from Machha Khola. Combined Manaslu Circuit + Tsum Valley: about 17-25 days (e.g. 17-day version: Tsum first, then Lokpa - Ghap - Lho - Samagaon - Samdo - Larkya La - Bimthang), requiring both the Manaslu RAP and the Tsum RAP. Some operators add Dhephyudonma Gompa above Mu Gompa or a Ganesh Himal base camp side trip. [s4, s5, s6, s7]

end_point: Machha Khola (out-and-back), or Dharapani if combined with the Manaslu Circuit

itinerary.route: Kathmandu - Arughat - Soti Khola - Machha Khola (drive)
itinerary.notes: Bus approx. 9-10 hours; Machha Khola given as 870-930 m. [s4, s5]
Lokpa is the Tsum Valley entry checkpoint (Tsum RAP checked). [s4, s5, s9]
Altitude 3,010-3,031 m in sources. [s5, s6, s8]

itinerary.route: Chhokangparo - Milarepa's Piren Phu cave - Nile / Chhule
Nile - Mu Gompa - return to Nile or down to Chhokangparo
Nile/Chhokangparo - Rachen Gompa - Chumling or Lokpa
itinerary.notes: Rachen (nunnery) approx. 3,220-3,240 m visited en route. [s4, s5, s6]

best_seasons.notes: After the 11 Oct 2026 Budhi Gandaki flood, MCAP issued a notice advising trekkers to suspend Tsum Valley trips; the cantilever bridge on the Arughat-Sirdibas section and the Sardibhir bridge at Lokpa were reported destroyed. Re-check status before selling departures. [s12, s13, s14]

permits.name: Tsum Valley Restricted Area Permit (Sirdibas-Lokpa-Chumling-Chekampar-Nile-Chule; Chumnubri RM wards 3, 6, 7)
permits.fee: Sep-Nov: USD 40 per person for first week + USD 7 per person per day beyond; Dec-Aug: USD 30 per person for first week + USD 7 per person per day beyond
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; Department of Immigration via registered agency

permits.name: Manaslu Restricted Area Permit - only if combining with the Manaslu Circuit
permits.fee: Sep-Nov: USD 100 first week + USD 15/day beyond; Dec-Aug: USD 75 first week + USD 10/day beyond
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals on the combined route

permits.name: Manaslu Conservation Area Permit (MCAP)
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,000)

permits.name: Annapurna Conservation Area Permit (ACAP) - only if exiting via Dharapani
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,000)

permits.name: TIMS card (agency-issued)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; NTB lists Tsum Valley Trek and Manaslu-Tsum Valley Trek under the guide + TIMS rule

permits.name: Local (rural municipality) fee
permits.fee: Reported as NPR 2,000 per person by one operator

guide_requirements: Restricted area: permit only via a government-registered trekking agency, with a licensed trekking guide. Since 22 March 2026 solo foreign trekkers can obtain restricted-area permits; the Kathmandu Post report names the Manaslu and Tsum Valley regions among the covered areas. Guide and agency rules remain, maximum seven trekkers per guide. [s11, s15]

drives: Kathmandu - Arughat - Soti Khola - Machha Khola: approx. 9-10 hours by bus/jeep (dirt road continues towards Philim in places depending on season)
logistics.notes: Basic lodges and homestays in Tsum villages. [s4, s6]

highlights: Tibetan-Buddhist villages of Chhokangparo, Nile and Chhule
Views of Ganesh Himal, Baudha and Himalchuli
Can be combined with the Manaslu Circuit and Larkya La
risks: Flood and landslide damage on the Budhi Gandaki approach (Oct 2026 flood destroyed bridges and trail sections; MCAP suspended Tsum trekking)
Moderate altitude up to approx. 3,700 m
Remote; limited lodges and evacuation by helicopter

acclimatization.notes: No dedicated rest day on the standalone route; the gradual ascent and the Nile/Mu Gompa day serve for acclimatization. Combined routes add a rest day at Samagaon. [s4, s6]

unverified: Whether the March 2026 solo-permit change applies to Tsum: Kathmandu Post names Tsum, but some Tsum-focused operator pages still state a two-trekker minimum.
TIMS requirement: NTB lists Tsum Valley Trek under TIMS, one operator says the RAP replaces TIMS.
Local rural municipality fee of NPR 2,000 is from a single operator site.
Whether a Tsum-only trek also needs the Manaslu RAP: operators say no (Tsum RAP + MCAP suffice), but Jagat (Chumnubri ward 3) appears in both RAP ward lists; confirm with the agency.
